name: diagrams
description: Turn any idea into a diagram: flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, timelines, Gantt charts, org charts, ER diagrams and more, rendered from Mermaid with PNG/SVG download and one-click editing.

interface.longDescription: Ask for a diagram and see it drawn right in the chat. Diagrams renders flowcharts, process maps, decision trees, mind maps, sequence diagrams, timelines, Gantt charts, org charts, entity-relationship diagrams, class and state diagrams, user journeys, quadrant charts, kanban boards and architecture diagrams. Download any diagram as a high-resolution PNG or a scalable SVG for slides and documents, or open it in the Mermaid Live Editor to fine-tune it. If a diagram has a syntax error, one click asks ChatGPT to fix it.
defaultPrompt: Draw a flowchart of our customer refund process.
Make a mind map for planning a product launch.
Create a Gantt chart for a 6-week website redesign.
